title: Scope of Strategic Partnership Co-Curricular Activity Programme
what_it_is: Scope of Strategic Partnership Co-Curricular Activity Programme

sections.label: SP-CCA expansion and partners
sections.summary: SP-CCA began in 2019 with athletics and ethnic dance, resumed in person and added water polo, with MOE monitoring and working with partners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: SP-CCA started in 2019, with athletics and ethnic dance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Resuming in-person activities this year, the programme has expanded to include a new team sport in water polo.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE will monitor the programme and consider the extension to other levels and areas in sports and the arts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE will continue to work closely with our partners to explore how the National Sports Associations might be involved in future.

sections.label: Extending SP-CCA activities
sections.summary: MOE wants to extend SP-CCA to more activities in sports and the arts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On the first question, indeed, we would like to extend SP-CCA to more activities in sports and the arts.

sections.label: SP-CCA as additional channel
sections.summary: SP-CCA is an add-on channel for students passionate about sports and the arts not offered by their schools, based on student preferences.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: So, the SP-CCA is actually an add-on, an additional channel for our students who have the passion to pursue sports and the arts that are not offered by their schools, or for various reasons, to be able to do so.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: So, the main consideration is our students' preferences and their passion.

sections.label: MOE and SportSG meetings
sections.summary: MOE and SportSG meet regularly to discuss desired CCA outcomes, with SportSG designing CCAs to suit students' learning needs and development outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOE and SportSG have regular meetings, where we discuss the outcomes desired of the CCA programmes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: That is where we get SportSG to design the CCAs to suit the learning needs and development outcomes that we want of our students.
